# Home

Welcome to Zhang Research Lab!

Zhang Research Lab (ZRL) is dedicated to an interdisciplinary research programme that bridges micro-/nanotechnology and functional materials with MEMS and robotics technology at small scales. The primary research objectives of the Laboratory range from development of functional nanomaterials to intelligent micro-/nanoscale machines and robotic systems for biomedical, energy storage and environmental applications. The motivation of our research is to develop enabling materials, tools and systems, and technologies for the sustainable society and a better life.

### ABOUT US

The Cheng Kar-Shun Robotics Institute (CKSRI) is a multidisciplinary platform that supports and facilitates robotics-related research, development and education. With a focus on autonomous systems and robotics research, the Institute integrates innovations in sensors, devices, systems, networks, neurosciences, data analytics and machine learning to further research by faculty and students in a wide range of applications that aim to create societal impact. The Institute also nurtures a network of industry partners, designs entrepreneurship programs and drives knowledge dissemination.

In 2015, HKUST launched its Robotics Institute, a major new multidisciplinary research initiative. The Institute supports the endeavors of faculty and students working on robotics and autonomous systems across the campus. 

 

In June 2021, the Institute was renamed the Cheng Kar-Shun Robotics Institute, following a generous donation from Chow Tai Fook Charity Foundation Limited to HKUST to support academic and research development.

# 苏州工学院开展机动车拆解行业核心技能人才专项培训

来源：本站 作者： 发布时间： 2026-05-26浏览次数：

2026年5月26日上午，由中国物资再生协会主办、苏州工学院承办，以“产教融合强技能 绿色拆解促发展”为主题的报废机动车回收拆解行业核心技能人才专项培训班开班仪式在苏州工学院东湖校区志道楼102学术报告厅隆重举行。中国物资再生协会汽车部主任曹辉、苏州工学院汽车工程学院党委书记陈友洋、培训专业教师张凯、班主任叶甜及全体参训学员共同参加开班仪式。

Image

开班仪式上，汽车工程学院党委书记陈友洋首先对培训班开班表示祝贺，并向与会嘉宾与全体学员表示欢迎。他介绍，苏州工学院作为省市共建公立本科院校，汽车工程学院深耕汽车工程应用型人才培养，建有省级汽车工程实践教育示范中心、苏州市汽车绿色拆解智能装备重点实验室等平台，在车辆结构优化、新能源汽车动力学、电池热管理等领域具备扎实科研与教学基础，可为本次培训提供优质师资、场地与实训保障。--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
